analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free in URLParser::parse due to binding a StringView (`processed_input`) to temporary storage owned by local `String processed_input_string`. When tab/newline are present, parse creates `processed_input_string`, mutates it with replace(), then assigns `processed_input = processed_input_string` (view into that String). After leaving the if-block, `processed_input_string` is destroyed (freeing StringImpl), but `Utf8View input(processed_input)` later iterates that dangling view, leading to UAF read in Utf8CodePointIterator::operator* (Utf8View.cpp:244).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: FuzzURL passes attacker-controlled bytes to URL constructor, which calls URLParser::parse. Input must be non-empty and contain '\t' or '\n' so the replacement branch runs. The parser then continues using `processed_input` after the local replacement String has gone out of scope, so subsequent UTF-8 iteration dereferences freed memory and crashes.
